plugins.name: aws-lambda
plugins.description: Deploy to AWS Lambda with SAM behind the Lambda Web Adapter — one overlay for every language, built by ap-build; credentials from the connected account's deploy role, no keys; readiness checks before a deploy; CloudFormation stacks and functions as tools
plugins.author: actionplatform
needs: tool: aws, sam (bundled as Python packages when not on PATH)
env: AWS_REGION; credentials from role_arn (the connected account's deploy role, OIDC, no keys) or the AWS CLI chain (SSO, profile, instance role)

plugins.name: dokploy
plugins.description: Deploy to Dokploy: the CI publishes a Docker image on every release and the platform points the Dokploy application at that tag — one overlay for every language on the images-base build and runtime images; readiness checks (settings, image published, key accepted, application state); projects, applications and deployments as tools; who has access to the instance and to each project, through the platform's access tools
plugins.author: actionplatform
needs: env: DOKPLOY_URL, DOKPLOY_API_KEY on a machine (the plugin's url and api_key options on the platform); AP_DOKPLOY_REGISTRY_USERNAME and AP_DOKPLOY_REGISTRY_PASSWORD for a private image
net: the Dokploy instance's url; the image registry (ghcr.io by default)

plugins.name: example
plugins.description: Template plugin: a tool, a command, a deploy target with readiness, an overlay, a release strategy, stricter git-flow
plugins.author: actionplatform

plugins.name: jenkins
plugins.description: Jenkins: the CI runner for deploys and Run CI, access through Role-based Authorization Strategy, and read-only tools for jobs, builds and the queue
plugins.author: actionplatform
needs: net: the host of the url option
env: AP_JENKINS_URL, AP_JENKINS_USER, AP_JENKINS_TOKEN (tools on a machine; the plugin's options are the fallback)
jenkins: the role-strategy plugin selected as the authorization strategy (access)

plugins.name: sentry
plugins.description: Manage who belongs to a Sentry organization and its teams through Connect Sentry, no pasted token; read a release's new issues and the errors after a deploy
plugins.author: actionplatform
needs: env: AP_SENTRY_ORG, AP_SENTRY_TOKEN, AP_SENTRY_URL on a machine (the plugin's options on the platform)
net: sentry.io, or the self-hosted Sentry's url
connection: the organization's Sentry connection on a hosted platform (core 0.34)
